works.title: Meme Strategy Book: Villain Archetypes and Foundational Left-Wing Political Messaging
works.description: A strategic and mythic work on using memes as foundational left-wing political communication, structured around iconic villain archetypes that root contemporary right-wing opponents in timeless narrative patterns. Intended to endure across generations by distinguishing ephemeral tactics (AI prompting, social platforms) from enduring cultural truths.
works.quote: In structuring the vision for memes, I want to create an iconic mythology to accompany it and help it endure. The targets we've discussed will never disappear, so if demonizing these groups and individuals reaches the level of archetype, then I'm not just writing a book for the time, but a book for the ages.
